_comment: Pipeline v2.0 — Master search queries configuration. Single source of truth for ALL web search queries used at any stage of the pipeline. Variables: {startup_name} = raw discovered name, {clean_name} = resolved brand name, {brand_name} = confirmed brand name used by resolvers.

initial_discovery._comment: Fired immediately after startup name is discovered. All 8 field buckets run in parallel. Variable: {startup_name}.

queries: {startup_name} company main OR direct competitors comparable companies
{startup_name} funding round details fund raised amount investors

internal_crawler_queries._comment: Used internally by the web crawler pipeline. NOT web search queries. Two sub-sections: bm25_queries (semantic retrieval from crawled text) and link_discovery_keywords (which sub-pages to visit).

bm25_queries._comment: Keyword strings for BM25 ranking of crawled page text chunks. One query per enricher domain. Each enricher calls get_bm25_query(enricher_key) to retrieve its string.
bm25_queries.corporate_query: legal name registered office address linkedin url founding year established headquarters location city state country
bm25_queries.identity_query: founders leadership team profiles background linkedin url histories executive officers co-founder CEO CTO
bm25_queries.product_query: products services solutions technology platforms categories features target customers deployment models pricing
bm25_queries.competitor_query: competitors alternatives comparable companies direct indirect market rivals substitutes competing products
bm25_queries.funding_query: funding round investment raised series seed investors valuation crore million lead co-investor capital

link_discovery_keywords._comment: URL routing keywords used to select which sub-pages to crawl from the homepage. Matched against href text and URL path segments.

fallback_and_ai_recheck._comment: Triggered automatically when an enricher detects missing/empty output fields. Uses the cleaner {clean_name} variable (resolved brand name). Also used by UI-triggered AI-Recheck for individual field re-enrichment.

queries: {clean_name} company main OR direct competitors comparable companies
{brand_name} funding round details fund raised amount investors

resolvers._comment: Used by website and LinkedIn resolver modules to confirm/refine the official URLs. Variable: {brand_name}.

leadership_resolver.funding_articles_query: "{brand_name}" founder OR CEO site:inc42.com OR site:yourstory.com

api_rechecks._comment: Legacy single-query keys retained for backward compatibility with UI-triggered re-enrichment API endpoints (/api/startups/{id}/recheck). Prefer fallback_and_ai_recheck for new code.

custom_web_search._comment: Suffix appended to user-entered search terms in the custom web search UI feature.
